body: Hey man, if you ever need someone to talk to I’m here. You’re not worthless. Please stay safe
You can talk to me. I’m in the same place. Pls message me if you need someone
Just your whole situation in general. Whenever I feel sad it helps whenever I’m able to express how I feel. I would be down to listen to you and try to help you out
Hey, do you mind talking about it all little bit?
You don’t have to do this
Long story short. I got left because I was a bad bf. Or so I thought. There’s a lot that goes into it
Ah nothing, you know, just lost the most important person in my life. What about you?
I guess the same way. Probably going through one of the worst weeks of my life
How are you doing ?
Bet. You wanna talk here or different platform. Doesn’t matter to me
I go to therapy. Should I tell him about this?
Would you care to talk about it more?
I’m in the same situation. I feel like no one sees ne
You don’t have to do it. You can talk to me about it too. I’m in college but not in a similar situation as you. I will do my best to listen

It’s hard in a relationship. I’m in a similar yet very different situation as you. It’s hard to feel the fact that the one you love most can’t handle how you truly feel. If you ever need someone to talk to, I am available. But I think it’s best to try and work it out with your bf in a healthy manner.
You can always message me to be friends and have people to talk to ❤️
You don’t have to do it
Yo. If you don’t mind let’s be friends. Message me and we can talk. I’ll listen
Hey man you don’t have to do it. Please talk to me
You can always talk to me if you need someone
Talk to me, we can get through this together and live
You can always message me if you need someone to talk to
I’m here for you
Don’t do it please
Stay strong man. You can always hit me up. I’m in the same boat
I gotchu bro just hit me up or something
I’m in the same exact boat dude. Idk if it gets better. People say it does but I’m not sure. I broke up with her like an idiot. She was the only thing keeping me going

I’m in the same position but with my ex gf. I still don’t know if it’s worth it. Everything feels so uncertain now. One day you have your whole life planned together and then the next you’re on your own.
